# Variable `SRCDATE`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

The date of the source code used to build the package. This variable applies only if the source was fetched from a Source Code Manager (SCM).

### BitBake User Manual

The date of the source code used to build the package. This variable applies only if the source was fetched from a Source Code Manager (SCM).
